name: live-code-compilation
title: Live Code Compilation
description: Split screen: code is typed on the left and the button on the right snaps to match on the exact frame each property finishes. On a tall frame the split stacks (code on top, preview below).
useWhen: You want cause and effect for a developer audience: a style prop finishes typing on the left and the button on the right changes on that exact frame.
The pitch needs an HMR moment where every property lands as a hard snap rather than an ease.
avoidWhen: The code on screen has to be yours: the typed fragments and the resulting button are fixed here; use glass-code-block or glass-code-walk with your own code.
The shot is about commands and their output: use a terminal block.
author: Remocn
